english.note: This is the all-purpose term for an abnormal fear of enclosed or tight spaces.

examples.english: I have claustrophobia, and I get scared when I enter a small windowless room.
examples.traditional: 我有幽閉恐懼症，入到冇窗嘅細房就會好驚。
